text_block_list.text: The day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.

Sakura Bakushin O burned with fighting 
spirit to cap off her rivalry with Nishino 
Flower in glorious fashion and return to 
her Bakushin road.

Right before the race, she stepped out 
toward the showdown, declaring to Nishino 
Flower that she would win by 1000 
lengths...!
